SELECT s.store_id, o.login_state, o.status,
       (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_has_member, (o.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS order_has_member,
       (f.member_key = o.member_key) AS same_key,
       count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders, sum(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900 OR f.channel_code='WB' OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH web AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, f.net_amount, f.member_key AS line_mk, o.member_key AS order_mk, o.login_state,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id = 900
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  count(*) AS n_lines, round(sum(net_amount),2) AS web_net,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN line_mk IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS member_line_net,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN order_mk IS NOT NULL THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS member_order_net,
  round(sum(CASE WHEN login_state='logged_in' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS loggedin_net,
  count(DISTINCT receipt_id) AS orders,
  sum(CASE WHEN line_mk IS NULL AND order_mk IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_lines
FROM web w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 35 AND 47
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-12-22' AS in_range_start, min(f.sale_date) AS first_sale, max(f.sale_date) AS last_sale,
       min(f.etl_loaded_at) AS first_etl, max(f.etl_loaded_at) AS last_etl, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS orders
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

WITH web AS (
  SELECT f.net_amount, o.member_key AS omk,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key AND s.store_id = 900
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
  WHERE o.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(net_amount) AS mine_before
  FROM web JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = dd
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_period, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS ctl_before, sum(r.returns_net) AS ctl_returns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
  WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.fiscal_period, m.mine_before, c.ctl_before, m.mine_before - c.ctl_before AS gap, c.ctl_returns
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_period) ORDER BY 1
